plugin.note: Ice warriors have a 100% weakness to fire spells, so Fire Bolt/Fire Blast is the fastest option. They also fall quickly to a strong crush or slash melee weapon such as a Dragon scimitar. Krystilia's task must be done in the Wilderness with risk-appropriate gear.

requirements: No Slayer level is required; only combat is needed to receive the task.
Krystilia's ice warriors must be killed in the Wilderness (Frozen Waste Plateau or other Wildy spawns).
mechanics: Ice warriors attack with slash melee for up to 6 damage at a 4-tick speed.
They have 59 Hitpoints and Defence 47, with a 100% weakness to fire spells.
The Frozen Waste Plateau shares spawns with ice giants and is a Wilderness PKer area.

methods.label: Fire spells
methods.summary: Exploit the 100% fire weakness with Fire Bolt or Fire Blast for the fastest kills.
requiredOrKeyItems: Fire spell runes (Fire Bolt / Fire Blast)
steps: Bring fire-spell runes and low-risk gear for the Wilderness.
Cast Fire Bolt or Fire Blast at ice warriors on the Frozen Waste Plateau.
Watch the minimap for PKers and teleport out when threatened.

methods.label: Melee
methods.summary: Use a Dragon scimitar or better; ice warriors' defence is modest and they die quickly.
steps: For Mazchna, go to the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon and attack ice warriors with melee.
For Krystilia, kill Wilderness ice warriors at the Frozen Waste Plateau with risk-appropriate gear.
Attack with any strong crush/slash weapon until the task completes.

body:
# Ice warriors

Ice warriors are assigned by Krystilia (Wilderness) and Mazchna (starter). They have 59 Hitpoints, Defence 47, and a 100% weakness to fire spells, so Fire Bolt/Fire Blast is fastest; a Dragon scimitar or better also clears them quickly. Krystilia's task must be done in the Wilderness at the Frozen Waste Plateau with risk-appropriate gear, while Mazchna's can be done safely in the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon.
